# SD13-E5 Ranger level 4 hybrid chassis baseline fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Ranger level 4 identity as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat) and stays a single-class, level-4 hybrid baseline, mirroring the
# level-3 fixture's shape with the class level swapped.
#
# Level 4 adds one new deterministic choice selection: Hunter's Bond
# (choice:ranger_hunters_bond -> form:bond), the PF1 Core Rulebook's 4th-level Ranger
# "Special" column entry. Hunter's Bond offers the ranger a one-time, permanent choice
# between two mutually exclusive forms: a bond to his hunting companions (granting
# allies within 30 feet who can see or hear him half the ranger's favored-enemy bonus
# against a single target, via a move action) or an animal companion. The "bond" form
# is the arbitrary but deterministic pick for this fixture, since it is the form with a
# flat-shaped magnitude component (half the already-grounded favored-enemy bonus); the
# "companion" form would require a full animal-companion stat block/advancement
# subsystem that does not exist in this codebase. This fixture carries forward the same
# favored-enemy, combat-style, and favored-terrain selections from the level-3 fixture
# unchanged, since none of those are re-granted at 4th level.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-ranger-level4
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:ranger:4
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:survival:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:strength
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy:enemy:humanoid_orc
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style:style:archery
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat:feat:point_blank_shot
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain:terrain:forest
choice=choice:ranger_hunters_bond:form:bond
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/sd13-e3-r5-paladin-and-ranger-hybrid-chassis-baseline-execution-handoff-2026-07-01.md
